ConsentForm.healthShareBody: Your data passes through the services that run the app — hosting, database, and the AI coach provider. They process it only for us, never for ads.
ConsentForm.healthShareDetail: The processors: Vercel (application hosting), Supabase (database), our AI model provider (coach responses only), and Sentry (error reports). Each works under contract, for us alone. Our analytics provider is deliberately NOT on this list — analytics never receives your workout content.
